description: Abstract compute capabilities available to a benchmark run. Deliberately platform-agnostic: it names no cluster, provider, account, or queue backend. The operator maps the class you choose onto a real platform.

suitable_for: analysis that fits a normal multi-core node
cpu.notes: Use when the work is CPU-shaped and correctness/verification dominates over wall-clock urgency.

suitable_for: JAX / PyTorch training or inference at scale
any step whose cost model is dominated by GPU kernels
gpu.notes: Billed by usage and therefore precious. A GPU must be justified scientifically, not by preference; CPU is always preferred when it can finish in budget.
